feishu-voice-chat v0.1.0

- Initial release providing Feishu voice chat capabilities for OpenClaw using Volcengine APIs.
- Supports automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS); all Feishu voice messages are processed by this skill.
- Enables end-to-end voice interaction: receive voice → ASR → LLM processing → TTS → reply via Feishu audio bubble.
- Integrates with openclaw-lark for seamless Feishu audio message sending.
- Includes clear CLI usage, setup, and troubleshooting instructions.
